details:
Q1. What exact part of this repository should change?
Choices:
A. One specific workflow, script, or file path — include its name/path and what is wrong. (RECOMMENDED)
B. One specific pipeline phase/behavior — include the phase (`clarify`, `plan`, `implement`, `review_autofix`, `orchestrate`, or `validate`) and the current vs desired behavior. (RECOMMENDED)
C. Docs/templates/setup guidance only — include the page/template and the improvement you want.
Q2. Which best describes the improvement you want?
Choices:
A. Fix something that is broken today — include the failure, error, or incorrect behavior. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Change or add one concrete behavior — include the exact desired result. (RECOMMENDED)
C. Docs/editorial polish only — include what is unclear or misleading.
Q3. What evidence should planning use?
Choices:
A. A workflow run, PR, issue, or log snippet that shows the problem. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A short “current behavior” vs “desired behavior” description. (RECOMMENDED)
C. A shortlist of exact files/workflows that are in scope, plus anything explicitly out of scope. (RECOMMENDED)
